source.table: SiegeEngineers/aoe2techtree - data/data.json, key path data.Tech[<id>]; cross-checked against HSZemi/aoe2dat - data/units_buildings_techs.json
source.rule: Table numbers are copied, never retuned. label/age/building are authored here (listed in authored[]) because the table carries no such columns, and design{} records the two effect halves the design fixed instead of the current DE rows. tools/check-stats.mjs regenerates index.html's TECHS block from this file and fails when the file and the game disagree.

design.techs.fletching.effect: +1 range (the DE row's range half) is not modelled - the engine has one attack number per unit, so only the +1 pierce attack half is ported
design.techs.bracer.effect: the armour half of the DE row (+1 pierce armour) instead of its attack/range half - the design fixes this
